claims.statement: Allocation rule set v18's split-reservation mechanism directly produced the held-order cohort: 100% of 186 held orders are scope EXC-0921 (v18 split-reservation allocations); no held order exists outside this scope.
claims.corroboration: m8_r_exceptions is a tier-1 discriminating artifact confirming perfect correlation between v18 allocation scope and held orders. m8_e03 establishes v18 is the only allocation-related change in the deployment window.
claims.limitation: Correlation established, but root cause mechanism remains open: v18 may contain a defect in its split-reservation logic, or it may be correct but interacting with a pre-existing issue on east-node carrier feed (lag, capacity, or slot confirmation problem).

claims.statement: The held orders have not reached the carrier for pickup; inventory levels reconcile within our system, suggesting the problem is downstream of allocation (carrier-side lag, slot rejection, or dock capacity).
claims.corroboration: Inventory Control (m8_e01) confirms totals reconcile. m8_e09 documents observability gap preventing direct visibility into carrier confirmation. m8_r_exceptions confirms allocation was executed correctly for this cohort (v18 split-reservation is working as intended), not a defect in reservation logic.
claims.limitation: This is speculative pending carrier-side handoff trace. No direct evidence that carrier received or rejected slots yet.

capability_gaps.capability: Carrier-side pickup slot receipt and confirmation status
capability_gaps.reason: Critical to discriminate between rule-defect (slots sent but carrier system rejected them) vs. carrier-feed-lag (slots not sent or delayed). Need trace_cohort_handoffs to confirm order reached carrier system, and confirm_with_carrier_ops to verify carrier's view of the slots.

next_action.rationale: With C4 established (v18 split-reservation directly produced this cohort), and inventory confirmed reconciled, the next highest-information diagnostic is the full handoff trace from allocation → carrier queue → carrier confirmation. This will reveal whether the allocation was handed off to carrier ops and whether carrier acknowledged or rejected the pickup slots.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Proof that orders reached carrier feed; confirmation of slot acceptance/rejection; timing of handoff relative to 06:00 held-order detection; any error or exception on carrier side.
